$comment: Corrections to HRA crosswalk labels that contradict the source's own node name. Applied by scripts/anatomy/build_detail_organs.mjs; the build fails if the source label no longer matches (so fixed upstream data is noticed). The ontology id is cleared when corrected rather than guessed.

corrections.label: Right apical segmental bronchus
corrections.evidence: Node name says apical. The same label is also used for VH_M_right_superior_bronchus, and the right superior segmental bronchus belongs to the lower lobe, while the apical bronchus supplies the upper lobe.

corrections.label: Right anterior basal segmental bronchus
corrections.evidence: Node name says anterior basal. The same label is also used for VH_M_right_posterior_bronchus.

corrections.label: Left posterior basal bronchopulmonary segment
corrections.evidence: Node is a lung segment (sibling of the other basal bronchopulmonary segments), not a bronchus. The bronchus label is already used by VH_M_left_posterior_basal_bronchus.
